title: Squadron safety survey turns up four more unreported near-midairs

tellings.quote: And as it turned out, there were like four other near midairs that our squadron had over the past, you know, few months with this issue that went unreported.

plain: Ryan Graves, a US Navy fighter pilot whose squadron flew from the Virginia Beach area, says that after a near collision in the air, his squadron did a safety survey and filed a hazard report, the Navy's formal safety warning. According to Graves, the survey showed about four other near-midair collisions over the past few months with the same issue, none of them reported. If true, it would mean pilots were nearly hitting unknown objects and keeping quiet about it.
